messages:
dev-sre: FYI saw a weird pattern this morning: hosted-gpu queue in us-west-2 ballooned, but cluster-autoscaler didn't provision more GPU nodes for ~12m. logs show gateway timeouts to the provisioning service.
jenna: Ugh. Was that the batch rerank jobs or regular inference?
dev-sre: Mostly short-lived inference traffic from a single tenant that spiked, plus some background evals. Not the big reserved Dedicated tenants.
tomas: Could be the preflight network check we added last month — if the preflight call to our on-prem IP fails, node creation gets delayed. Any errors in node-launch logs?
dev-sre: Yep found repeated `preflight-check failed: dial tcp <private-ip>:443: i/o timeout` entries. Then the autoscaler gave up after X retries.
ops_raj: That preflight was meant to protect Dedicated setups (VPC onboarding), but it's now applied to the ephemeral burst pool too? If so that's bad for hosted fallback.
jenna: It is — we wired the same validation hook into the node bootstrapping script to ensure KMS access. But for hosted ephemeral nodes that should be optional.
dev-sre: Suggestion: split the validation path by nodepool label. If `nodepool-role=hosted-ephemeral` then skip external VPC checks. Adds risk but improves launch MTTR. Thoughts?
tomas: Strong +1. Also add a short circuit: if network check fails but instance metadata reachable, proceed with a degraded flag so ops can audit.
jenna: We need to be explicit on the isolation boundary though. If ephemeral nodes skip KMS checks, they must never be used for Dedicated tenant workloads. Enforce with taints/tolerations and admission controller.
ops_raj: Agreed. Proposal sketch: \n```\n# cluster-autoscaler config snippet\nnodeGroupAutoDiscovery: { kubeLabel: "nodepool-role=hosted-ephemeral" }\nscaleDownDelay: 10m\npreflight.policy: "skip-vpc"   # new flag\n```\nThen have admission webhook reject pods with `redwood/tenant=dedicated` on pools with `preflight.policy=skip-vpc`.
jenna: Nice. Also let's make sure networking errors are surfaced to SLOs — currently the autoscaler logs are ephemeral and we miss the correlation with gateway outages. Add a metric `autoscaler.node_launch.fail_reason`.
dev-sre: I'll add the metric and a small dashboard tile mapping fail_reason to region and nodepool.
autoscaler-bot: Notice: scale-up event for nodepool hosted-ephemeral/us-west-2 requested 3 GPUs at 1876543325, provisioning pending.
ops_raj: One more catch: cost. Ephemeral nodes have higher spot-interruption rates and egress to tenant endpoints can blow out billing if not metered. We should tag all ephemeral launches with `cost-center=hosted-burst` and enforce token-level metering.
tomas: Use a lifecycle hook to attach `billing-annotations` on instance start. We can also limit sustained CPU/token usage per namespace for burst pools via ResourceQuota and TokenQuotas.
jenna: For rollout: 1) implement `preflight.policy` flag, 2) enforce admission controller rule, 3) dashboard + metric, 4) add billing tags, 5) try in us-west-2 only for a week.
dev-sre: I'll open a small RFC and a short runbook for oncall. Quick ACTIONS: @tomas add admission webhook prototype, @ops_raj add billing-tags automation, @jenna update bootstrap scripts to respect `preflight.policy`.
ops_raj: I'll also add a short circuit in the network check to treat private-timeouts as transient and retry with exponential backoff instead of abort immediately.
dev-sre: Sounds good. Leaving a note: we mustn't allow dedicated tenant namespaces to be scheduled onto hosted-ephemeral by mistake — double-check taint keys: `redwood.dedicated=true:NoSchedule`.
jenna: will do. Also add a test that simulates gateway blackhole and verifies autoscaler still scales ephemeral pool up.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline kicked: branch=feat/ephemeral-preflight-flag, CI=green, preview env ready.
dev-sre: Nice — let's test in preview and then small canary in us-west-2 tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
